title: ZLIB Compressed Data Format Specification version 3.3
abstract: Zlib wraps compressed data in a stream with a header and an Adler-32 checksum.

title: DEFLATE Compressed Data Format Specification version 1.3
abstract: DEFLATE represents repeated strings using length and distance pairs and encodes symbols with Huffman codes.

title: GZIP file format specification version 4.3
abstract: Gzip stores compressed members with headers, trailers and a CRC-32 checksum.

title: RFC 8949: Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR)
abstract: CBOR represents structured data compactly and defines encoding rules for interchange.

title: RFC 9000: QUIC: A UDP-Based Multiplexed and Secure Transport
abstract: QUIC multiplexes streams over UDP and integrates a secure transport handshake.

title: RFC 9001: Using TLS to Secure QUIC
abstract: This specification describes how TLS provides handshake and packet protection for QUIC.

title: RFC 9002: QUIC Loss Detection and Congestion Control
abstract: This document describes acknowledgment processing, loss detection and congestion control for QUIC.

authors: Roy T. Fielding, Mark Nottingham, Julian Reschke
title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
abstract: This document defines HTTP request methods, response status codes and representation metadata.

authors: Roy T. Fielding, Mark Nottingham, Julian Reschke
title: RFC 9111: HTTP Caching
abstract: This document specifies response storage, freshness, validation and invalidation in HTTP caches.

authors: Roy T. Fielding, Mark Nottingham, Julian Reschke
title: RFC 9112: HTTP/1.1
abstract: This document describes message framing, parsing and connection management for HTTP/1.1.

title: RFC 9113: HTTP/2
abstract: This document describes multiplexed streams, frames and flow control in HTTP/2.

title: RFC 9114: HTTP/3
abstract: This document maps HTTP semantics to QUIC streams and defines the HTTP/3 framing layer.
